svg.title: Colors LFM3-1.7B names for each digit
svg.desc: Grid of ten digits by eleven basic color words. Square area is the share of 1,000 sampled answers naming that color for that digit; a full square is 30%. Black is large for 0 and 8 and small elsewhere. Purple is largest for 9 and 7. White and blue are near-equal for 1; yellow leads for 2 and 4.
